description: Fuzzing test code for the Chromium project's DNS host resolver, including classes and functions to create, manage, and cancel DNS requests using fuzzed parameters, aimed at testing the host resolver implementation.

classes.name: DnsRequest
classes.description: Class representing a DNS request that can be created, canceled, and waited upon, with fuzzed parameters for testing the host resolver.

classes.name: FuzzerEnvironment
classes.description: Class to initialize the environment for DNS fuzzing tests, setting up necessary task runners.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Static method to create and start a DNS request with fuzzed parameters, adding it to the dns_requests list if pending.

methods.name: WaitForRequestComplete
methods.description: Static method to wait for a randomly selected DNS request to complete.

methods.name: CancelRequest
methods.description: Static method to cancel a randomly selected DNS request.

methods.name: OnCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon DNS request completion, managing request lifecycle and fuzzed control flow.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates a DNS request with fuzzed parameters, returning status code.

methods.name: WaitUntilDone
methods.description: Blocks until the DNS request completes.

methods.name: IsParameterCombinationAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a set of DNS request parameters is valid for execution.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the DNS request if it is pending.

methods.name: EnsureInitFuzzerEnvironment
methods.description: Initializes the environment for DNS fuzzing tests.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: Main entry point for the fuzzing process, feeding fuzzed data into DNS request creation and management.
